integrity: The mathematical proof establishes the all-length claim; finite code tests independently sample definitions and coefficient identities. Cites and distinguishes earlier arch-factorisation results. No independent validation or peer review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Even-length reverse-complement palindromes for fixed-point-free involutions of even-sized labelled alphabets; does not count cyclic equivalence classes, approximation, or embedding multiplicities. A similarly formulated existing enumeration remains possible.
title: Complete subsequence-universality spectrum of reverse-complement palindromes
